title: b7z9.47(a): reconcile duplicate pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic entry in .clang-tidy
description: Smallest child of worker6-b7z9.47 (R-APPC-010 clang-tidy conformance). lichen/.clang-tidy enables cppcoreguidelines-pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic at :15 (spec-mandated CERT rule) and disables it again at :41 as the last entry — later entry wins, so the check is silently OFF, contradicting the header's policy citation. The trailing disable is UNDOCUMENTED (the 2mla rationale comment block lists 7 other suppressions but not this one). Fix: remove the undocumented trailing disable so the spec-mandated check is active; empirically measure impact on the host-compilable C subset (freestanding files like link_ctx.c/time_sync.c/rf_health.c/router.c); fix any findings or file them. Do NOT attempt the CI compile-DB/head-50 work — that is the sibling child.
